entries.label: Vera C. Rubin Observatory
entries.quote: A powerful new telescope will come online this year in a remote region of Chile and begin a decade-long survey of the southern sky.

entries.label: Generative AI search
entries.quote: Generative search promises to make finding what you're looking for simple and quick.

entries.label: Small language models
entries.quote: Cheaper and less power-hungry small language models can now stand with the heavyweights across a range of specific tasks.

entries.label: Cattle burping remedies
entries.quote: A food supplement that significantly reduces the amount of methane that cattle belch is now available in dozens of countries.

entries.label: Robotaxis
entries.quote: Robotaxis have completed years of beta testing, and they are now finally becoming available to the public.
entries.note: Availability from the article's 'WHEN' line; key players from 'WHO'.

entries.label: Cleaner jet fuel
entries.quote: New fuels made from used cooking oil, industrial waste, or even gasses in the air could help power planes without fossil fuels.

entries.label: Fast-learning robots
entries.quote: Thanks to today's generative AI boom, robots are now learning new tasks faster than ever.

entries.label: Long-acting HIV prevention meds
entries.quote: A trial of a new HIV prevention medicine found that 100% of treated women and girls were protected from acquiring HIV infections.

entries.label: Green steel
entries.quote: Making steel is one of the largest industrial sources of carbon dioxide, emitting more carbon than all of India.

entries.label: Stem-cell therapies that work
entries.quote: Experimental transplants of lab-made cells seem to be helping treat two very different conditions—epilepsy and type 1 diabetes.

entries.label: Brain-computer interfaces
entries.quote: Implants that help people communicate or operate machines are being tested in dozens of clinical trials.
entries.note: Reader-voted 11th entry, added 2025-04-01 (47% of votes). Not one of the editors' ten.

notes: Ten entries plus a reader-voted 11th (Brain-computer interfaces, added 2025-04-01). Article pages carry 'WHO' (key players) and 'WHEN' (availability) lines. Only the Robotaxis article was read; other entries have null availability and key_players. Quote is the list-page dek.
